verdict.rationale: Epic's docs confirm Blueprints let designers use most programmer-level concepts without writing code (unreal-docs-1), directly supporting visual-scripting gameplay logic. However, hands-on community reports describe real limits — Blueprints being insufficient for tasks like vehicle scripting without C++, performance/complexity issues cascading in large Blueprint graphs, and users needing to drop to C++ for things like JSON parsing — indicating the no-code promise has practical caveats at scale. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks/case studies quantifying how far pure-Blueprint projects can scale, and clearer guidance on when Blueprints alone suffice vs require C++.
